n: MakeCode for Adafruit and Maker boards
t: A browser editor for programming the Adafruit Circuit Playground Express with blocks.
steps: Open the MakeCode editor for Circuit Playground Express in a browser.
Build a light program and run it in the simulator.
Download the program and copy the file to the board.
Explore the MakeCode Course for Circuit Playground Express.
Check if offline use works before relying on it.
